text.p: Muriel Siebert Capital Markets Group Inc said Monday it has completed its merger with J. Michaels Inc, forming a company to be known as Siebert Financial Corp.
Siebert Financial is a holding company that conducts all its operations through its wholly owned subsidiary, Muriel Siebert & Co Inc.
Siebert, a retail discount brokerage and investment banking firm, will trade under the ticker symbol, on the Nasdaq Small Cap Market beginning Tuesday, November 12.
Muriel Siebert, chief executive of Muriel Siebert & Co Inc, will serve as chief executive of Siebert Financial Corp, and will own 97.5 percent of the shares of the newly formed corporation.

Shareholders of J. Michaels Inc prior to the merger will receive an initial liquidating dividend of $11.50 and a non-transferable interest in future liquidating dividends from the sale of remaining assets, it said.

Michaels' stockholders received 2.5 percent of the shares of Siebert Financial in addition to the liquidating trust dividends. For every seven Michaels shares held, former Michaels' stockholders will receive one share of Siebert Financial.
